caption: The drawing depicts a single andiron, colored in shades of brass or gold with black accents. The andiron has a tall vertical structure with a rounded finial at the top, followed by a series of bulges and curves that lead down to a shaft with geometric detailing. At the base, it splits into three curved legs, each terminating in a small sphere. A horizontal black metal bar extends back from the main vertical shaft. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background, and it is contained within a thin-ruled rectangular border. There is faint handwritten text near the top right and along the right edge outside the main border.
title: Andiron
